instruction: I'd like to customize the VLC volume slider to use a blue color scheme. Can you change the slider colors to bluish tones?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC volume slider colors to a blue theme. The evaluator checks if qt-slider-colours setting contains primarily bluish RGB values (high B, low R/G) in the VLC configuration file. Similar to original and variation 5, but with blue color requirement.
metadata.verification: Created custom metric check_qt_slider_colours__343f3ef0 that checks for bluish colors (B > 150 AND B > R+50 AND B > G+50).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific location
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes are persisted
Metric correctly parses qt-slider-colours setting and checks all color values
Bluish definition (B > 150, B > R+50, B > G+50) is semantically reasonable
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove or clarify the hardcoded default value at vlc.py:14 - currently uses non-bluish default '153;210;153;20;210;20;255;199;15;245;39;29' which is misleading
Consider whether requiring ALL colors to be bluish is too strict - VLC sliders have multiple zones (background, foreground, border) and typically only the main slider color needs to match the theme
Add explicit logging when qt-slider-colours setting is not found in config file to improve debuggability
